top_signals.title: US Space Force, Japan launch sensor to bolster space surveillance above Indo-Pacific
top_signals.summary: In a bilateral space effort, the U.S. Space Force successfully launched a Space Domain Awareness payload aboard Japan’s Quasi-Zenith Satellite 7.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Credit card issuer Synchrony partners with OpenAI for ChatGPT shopping
top_signals.summary: Maran Nalluswami, Synchrony's chief strategy officer, told CNBC it will probably take six to 12 months to get payments fully integrated into ChatGPT.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Casas Bahia Files for Bankruptcy on High Rates, Tight Credit
top_signals.summary: Grupo Casas Bahia SA filed for bankruptcy protection in Sao Paulo, after an out-of-court debt restructuring with its main creditors proved insufficient to resolve its financial troubles.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Harmony plans pre-attack rollback after exploiter forged 3 trillion ONE tokens
top_signals.summary: Harmony considered alternatives, including a token burn & blacklisting wallets, but concluded a rollback was "fairest and most secure."
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Microsoft working on Defender patch for ShieldBreak zero-day
top_signals.summary: Microsoft is working on a security patch for the "ShieldBreak" zero-day vulnerability disclosed last week by security researcher "Nightmare Eclipse" and now tracked as CVE-2026-69414. [...]
